title: Why I love trains
instructions: Peter neden trenle seyahat etmeyi sevdiğini anlatıyor. Karşılaştırmalara dikkat et.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: I travel a lot for work, and I always go by train if I can.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: Flying is faster, but airports are stressful and you wait for hours.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: On the train, I can read, work on my laptop or just look out of the window.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: Trains are also better for the environment than planes or cars.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: Last month, I went from London to Edinburgh by train. It took four and a half hours.

script.speaker: peter
script.text: The only problem is that train tickets can be expensive if you buy them late.

questions.prompt: What does Peter say about flying?
options: It's faster, but airports are stressful.
questions.feedback: Uçmak daha hızlı ama havalimanları stresli.
questions.evidence: Flying is faster, but airports are stressful

questions.prompt: How long did the trip to Edinburgh take?
questions.feedback: Edinburgh yolculuğu dört buçuk saat sürdü.
questions.evidence: It took four and a half hours.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with trains?
options: Tickets can be expensive if you buy them late.
questions.evidence: train tickets can be expensive if you buy them late.
